name: handily-board
description: A board with two panes, one open at a time: this session shows the task list that Claude and you share, and this machine reads a session store folder and shows its open owner asks and every session in it. /board opens it, four model tools keep the list, and a fifth records findings that you file, fix or dismiss.

mode.title: Board mode
mode.description: off: the board opens only on /board or /board machine. toggle: as off, and /board on a shown this session tab closes the board. always: the board opens when the session starts.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: attention: while the this session tab is not shown, the status line names an agent that waits for permission. off: the board sets no status line.

band.title: Task band
band.description: on: while the this session tab is not shown, one line above the prompt shows the current task, done of total and an approved plan that waits. off: the board draws no band.

store.title: Session store
store.description: The absolute path of the folder that holds sessions/ and asks/. A leading ~/ starts from your home folder. Not set: the this machine tab names this option and reads nothing.

answerWindow.title: Answer window
answerWindow.description: The name of the session whose board fills the prompt box when you press an option of an ask. In every other session the options show read only. Not set: every session shows them read only.
